nodes.name: Amine-functionalised graphene synthesis
nodes.procedure: Graphene oxide (GO) was first synthesised by a modified Hummers' method. Then, NH₄OH solution (0.5 mL) was added dropwise to a GO aqueous suspension (5 mL, 2 mg mL⁻¹) and stirred for 20 min. The mixed suspension was transferred to a Teflon vessel at 70 °C for 5 h under airtight conditions. After cooling and six times washing using water, the purified AGNs were obtained.

nodes.name: Cu²⁺ immobilization and freeze-drying
nodes.procedure: 80 μL CuCl₂·6H₂O (3 mg mL⁻¹) was added to the well-dispersed AGNs solution under stirring for 1 h. The purified samples were subsequently transferred into a freeze-drying vessel, which had been set at the temperature of -53 °C and vacuum pressure of -30 Pa. After being freeze-dried, the Cu²⁺-containing AGNs were obtained.

nodes.name: Microwave synthesis of PSB-CuN3
nodes.procedure: The Cu²⁺-containing AGNs, together with small amounts (≈1 wt%) of thermally reduced (300 °C for 1 h in Ar) graphene as catalysts, were sealed in an Ar gas-protected glass vial and then undergo a microwave process (microwave digestion workstation XH-800C) under 1000 W for 5 s. PSB-CuN3 was collected after a cooling period for 20 min.

nodes.characterization_summary: Three types of N species (graphitic 401.2 eV, pyrrolic 399.4 eV, pyridinic 398.6 eV) show no obvious difference; Cu 2p peaks at 932.0 eV (2p3/2) and 951.8 eV (2p1/2) indicate Cu1+ lower than Cu2+ at 934.3/954.1 eV in PS-CuN4.
nodes.evidence_snippet: While three types of graphitic (401.2 eV), pyrrolic (399.4 eV) and pyridinic (398.6 eV) N species for stabilising the Cu atoms exhibit no obvious difference, the Cu 2p spectrum of PSB-CuN3 possesses two dominant peaks at binding energies of 932.0 eV (2p3/2) and 951.8 eV (2p1/2) that are obviously lower than the characteristic binding energies of 934.3 and 954.1 eV for the Cu2+ in PS-CuN4, implying a lower valence state of Cu1+ in PSB-CuN3.

nodes.characterization_summary: PSB-CuN3 dominated by Cu¹⁺ at 571.1 eV; PS-CuN4 by Cu²⁺ at 572.0 eV.
nodes.evidence_snippet: PSB-CuN₃ is dominated by Cu¹⁺ species located at 571.1 eV, PS-CuN₄ is dominated by Cu²⁺ species located at 572.0 eV.

nodes.characterization_summary: Larger number of structural defects in PSB-CuN3 compared with PS-CuN4.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Raman spectra show there are a larger number of structural defects in PSB-CuN₃ compared with PS-CuN₄.

nodes.characterization_summary: PSB-CuN3: coordination numbers 2.8 (Cu-N at 1.98 Å) and 2.9 (Cu-C at 2.65 Å), indicating CuN₃C₃ configuration; PS-CuN4: 4.0 (Cu-N at 2.00 Å) and 4.1 (Cu-C at 2.67 Å), indicating CuN₄C₄.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the best-fit for PSB-CuN₃ demonstrates reduced coordination numbers (2.8 for Cu–N and 2.9 for Cu–C) with contracted interatomic distances (1.98 Å for the first Cu–N and 2.65 Å for Cu–C) ... CuN₃C₃ configuration.
